:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.1, Chap 4.3.8 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/itemLocationCode.xml).
:::

`itemLocationCode` is the last character of the data module code (DMC). It states where the item that the information is about is located.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 4 elements carry this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dmCode` | 28 | Required |
| `catalogSeqNumberRef` | 17 | Optional |
| `categoryOneContainerLocation` | 1 | Optional |
| `updateCode` | 1 | Required |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided in two steps: by the XML schema and by BREX (Business Rules Exchange).

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `itemLocationCodeAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The values are the enumeration `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, `T` |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00138) | Allows 5 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//@itemLocationCode`. The rule applies to all schemas |

BREX-S1-00138 allows the following values and defines how a lower-level BREX can tailor each of them.

| Value | `valueForm` | `valueTailoring` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `B` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `C` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `D` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `T` | `single` | `lexical` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `A` | Information about items installed on the Product |
| `B` | Information about items on a major assembly that was removed from the Product |
| `C` | Information about items on the bench |
| `D` | Information that applies to all three of `A`, `B` and `C` |
| `T` | Information about training |

## Related rules

- A BREX data module and a business rules document data module have `itemLocationCode` `D` (BREX-S1-00268 and BREX-S1-00265 of the default BREX).

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`list_data_modules`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/list-data-modules/) and [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is returned as a part of the data module code |
| Decide it when a data module is created | `allocation.rules.itemLocationCode` of [`build_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/build-data-module/) |
